summary.en: The camera travels one drawing to the next sheet while an ink arrow draws across the gutter on its easing and lands with it.
summary.zh: 镜头在同一张图上移到下一张图，一支墨色箭头按镜头的缓动划过图间空白，与镜头同时到达。

fits: Every seam between two sheets of a blueprint film.
notFor: Seams into or out of the overview (a pull-out); cuts between different drawings.

intent.en: Keep one space: the camera travels the drawing and the route line pulls the eye to the next sheet, so nothing is a cut.
intent.zh: 保持同一个空间：镜头在图上移动，路线把视线拉向下一张，没有一处是硬切。

content.en: The two sheets and the direction of travel (right, left, down).
content.zh: 两张图和移动方向（右、左、下）。

fits.zh: blueprint 片子中两张图之间的每一处接缝。

notFor.zh: 进出总览的接缝（那是拉远）；两张不同图纸之间的剪切。

en: The scene bricks draw their own arrival (lead 1); use route-pan where the host draws both sheets in one world, not on top of a scene's own arrival.
zh: 场景积木自带进场（lead 1）；只有宿主把两张图画在同一世界时才用 route-pan，不要叠在场景自己的进场上。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
